mechanics.definition: 在指定盘面、步骤或完整入口范围内，合格符号数量满足阈值规则后进入由节点引用唯一标识的目标Feature或奖励状态。
evidence_signatures: eligible symbol count and threshold evaluation are observable
the matching count event is linked to an explicit transition into the referenced target node
exclusions: random transition not caused by visible or state-held symbol count
symbol count pays directly but causes no state transition
persistent state reaches a threshold after multiple entries

mechanics.definition: 在明确合格机会中，由独立随机事件决定是否进入由节点引用唯一标识的目标Feature或奖励状态，触发结果不能由当前可见符号条件确定。
evidence_signatures: a distinct RNG decision or protocol event precedes the feature transition
identical visible symbol conditions can produce trigger and non-trigger outcomes under eligible state
exclusions: visible symbol count or pattern fully determines the transition
a persistent state threshold deterministically causes entry
the random event only selects an award inside an already entered feature

mechanics.definition: 命名持久状态节点的状态变量达到或跨越明确阈值后，在规定时点进入由节点引用唯一标识的目标Feature或奖励状态。
evidence_signatures: state value before and after the triggering update is observable
the threshold evaluation and target transition are linked in the state chain
exclusions: a single-board symbol count directly triggers without persistent state
independent random event triggers below the threshold
threshold only changes a multiplier or level without entering a target state
